app_info.subtitle: Plan trips and build packs
app_info.description: PackRat is an outdoor adventure planner. It helps you build and weigh packing lists, plan multi-day trips, search a large outdoor gear catalog by natural language, check weather for a destination, and read outdoor guides. Tools cover reading and writing your own packs, trips, and pack templates, plus read-only lookups for gear, trails, weather, and guides.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches current conditions and forecast for a location and returns them without storing or changing any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads live forecast data from a third-party weather provider outside PackRat.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only retrieves forecast data and cannot delete, overwrite, or otherwise alter any record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new trip record in the signed-in user's PackRat account.
justifications.open_world_justification: The trip is private to the user's account and is not published to any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new trip and never removes or overwrites an existing one.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new pack record in the signed-in user's PackRat account.
justifications.open_world_justification: The pack is created private to the user's account and is not published externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new pack and never deletes or overwrites existing packs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a gear item row to one of the user's packs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private pack contents within PackRat.
justifications.destructive_justification: Appends a new item and leaves existing items in the pack untouched.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the signed-in user's packs without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the user's own PackRat account data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs a read query and cannot alter or remove any pack.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a total, base, worn, and consumable weight breakdown from the pack's existing items without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's own pack contents inside PackRat.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns a calculated breakdown and writes nothing back to the pack.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares the pack's existing categories against recommended essentials and returns what is missing without adding anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's own pack data within PackRat.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reports missing categories and never removes or replaces existing items.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a vector similarity query over the PackRat gear catalog and returns matches.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches PackRat's own catalog rather than the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Executes a read-only search that cannot modify catalog data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Finds catalog items similar to an item already in the user's pack and returns them as suggestions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries PackRat's own catalog and the user's pack, not external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns suggestions only and does not swap, remove, or edit any pack item.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a full-text search across PackRat's published outdoor guides.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches PackRat's own guide content store rather than the open web.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs a read-only search that cannot change guide content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches the full text of one published guide by ID.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from PackRat's own guide content store.
justifications.destructive_justification: Retrieves guide content and cannot edit or delete it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates season-appropriate packing suggestions from the user's existing inventory and returns them without saving.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the user's own PackRat inventory and does not write to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Produces suggestions only and does not modify any pack or inventory record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the gear items currently in one of the user's packs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's own private pack contents.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs a read query and leaves all items unchanged.

test_cases.description: Plan a trip end to end, including weather, a saved trip, and a matching pack.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a 3-day backpacking trip to Tuolumne Meadows in Yosemite starting tomorrow. Check the weather, then create a trip and build a pack for it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the near-term forecast for the destination, then confirms a newly created trip and a newly created pack containing appropriate backpacking gear items.

test_cases.description: Search the gear catalog with natural language and compare the top results on weight and price.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search the PackRat gear catalog for ultralight sleeping pads under 500 grams and compare the top three on weight and price.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching ultralight sleeping pads from the catalog under roughly 500 grams, then a side-by-side comparison of the top three on weight and price. Rating is shown where the catalog has one and omitted where it does not, since rating coverage is partial. The comparison is presented in the response itself; there is no separate comparison tool call.

test_cases.description: Analyze an existing pack's weight and identify missing essentials.
test_cases.user_prompt: What's the total weight of my Tuolumne Meadows pack, and am I missing any essentials?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the pack whose name contains Tuolumne Meadows, returns its total weight with a base, worn, and consumable breakdown, then lists missing gear the pack analysis flags, with the must-have items called out ahead of the nice-to-have ones.

test_cases.description: Build a pack and then swap the heaviest items for lighter options.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a backpacking pack for a cold, wet weekend, then find lighter alternatives for my heaviest items.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the pack with suitable cold and wet weather gear, reports the heaviest items by weight, and proposes lighter catalog alternatives for them.

test_cases.description: Look up destination guidance from published guides and seasonal suggestions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search PackRat's guides for water filtration tips, and give me season-appropriate packing suggestions for Zion in November.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant guide content on water filtration plus season-appropriate packing suggestions for the stated location and month. If no guide matches the query, the app says so plainly and still returns the seasonal suggestions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for flight or hotel booking requests, which the app cannot perform.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a flight to Denver and a hotel near the park for next weekend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not book travel or lodging.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for turn-by-turn navigation or live trail routing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Give me turn-by-turn directions to the trailhead and track my hike as I walk it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it provides no live navigation or activity tracking.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general shopping outside outdoor gear planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Order a new laptop charger and have it delivered tomorrow.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not place orders and the item is unrelated to outdoor gear planning.
